about: lane ps2cast (2026-10-15): r117 room package = the em11 type 7 zealot as a POOL descriptor (NATIVE_MODEL_REGISTRY_POOL; model_registry.py --pool): body 0x1FC / TPL 0x1FD, heads 0x1FE / 0x1FF / 0x200 (TPL 0x201), right hands 0x204..0x207 and left hands 0x208..0x20C (TPL 0x1FD), hoods 0x202 / 0x203 (TPL 0x1FD), accessories 0x20D / 0x20F / 0x211 / 0x213 / 0x215 / 0x217 (TPL = BIN + 1), all from the PS2 em11 BINs. Render only. With PS2_ASHLEY_ROOMS=1 Ashley's r117 package goes beside it as partner.re4nmr.
lighting: lit preset (normals kept); the runtime decides flat vs source lighting
